chunks: Muhammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “Whoever gives a charity, and inheritance returns it to him, then it belongs to him.”
ai.seo_question: If something I gave in charity returns to me through inheritance, does it belong to me?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person gives something as charity and later that same property returns to him through inheritance, it is lawful for him to possess it. It clarifies a legal ruling concerning the intersection of charity and inheritance in financial law.
